2026-11-23.restoration: incremental chain continuation over the extras files on main up to 2026-11-22, generated by gen_chain.py (fallback=None: no ledger-rebuild estimates added by this generator). Elo was advanced from each horse's latest prior appearance file by the repo's own _elo_apply over confirmed results in the stored-details corpus. TONIGHT'S CARD SOURCE DIFFERS: the production API detail endpoint was unavailable all evening (D1 free-tier daily row-read limit, HTTP 500; reset 2026-11-23 09:00 JST, after the 06:00 issuance deadline), so the 2026-11-23 cards (57 races: Tokyo 12, Fukushima 12, Mizusawa 12, Kanazawa 10, Saga 11; Banei not held/excluded) were assembled from netkeiba public shutuba/shutuba_past pages by extras-rebuild-work/build_details_from_netkeiba.py (real recorded past-5 runs only; nothing estimated), and the 2026-11-22 Kyoto results (the only 2026-11-22 races present in the extras series, 11 races) were merged from netkeiba result pages into the cards restored from the production static pack. Other 2026-11-22 venues were never in the extras series, so a horse whose only intermediate run was on 2026-11-22 outside Kyoto keeps its earlier chain state or stays elo-missing - absent, not estimated. Guard applied: horses with no elo in their seed file stay elo-missing (no ELO_INIT fallback post values), verified on the generated file by verify_chain_output.py (guard_ok, 0 violations). Seed files: 2026-11-12 is the chain-restored file (commit 1648b45, estimatedStateUsed false); 2026-11-13 is the refetch replay candidate explicitly adopted by user decision on 2026-11-12 (its own provenance declares estimatedStateUsed true) and 2026-11-14..2026-11-22 inherit that disclosure, so horses whose chain passes through 2026-11-13..2026-11-22 inherit that replay state - disclosed here, not presented as genuine-series exact.
2026-11-23.speedMethod: build_speed_adjusted recomputed over the stored details corpus (real recorded runs only); pool is smaller than the original export's, so spd values may differ slightly from the original export

trialSpd2Supplements.method: spd2 conversion identical to the production yardstick (shadow_v8.build_speed_adjusted over the same speed pool gen_chain.py used): par = median of all pool race times at (track, surface, distance) dated strictly before the trial date (>= 5 samples); raw = trial_time - par; when the trial day's own variant stands, value = raw - variant (form=variant-adjusted), otherwise value = raw (form=raw-no-variant). spd2_recent = spd2_best = the single trial value. Elo is never derived from trials.
trialSpd2Supplements.principles: pass rows of official ability trials only （能力試験/能力検査/能力審査）; conversion only where races exist at the same track/surface/distance; unfound or unconvertible horses stay unsupplemented and are listed with reasons; JRA first starters out of scope (no ability-trial system); banei excluded
